q1_issues.issue: (Member sk_shirt_1 green) asserts that this shirt IS green, but the text says only that a green version is available, so the atom over-asserts a property the words do not put there.

(Also green sk_shirt_1) puts an entity witness in the slot the instruction set reserves for the event — the copular clause reifies no event, so the focus atom's second argument has no licensed filler.

q2_gaps: "available in <colour>" — the variant/configuration "in" PP on a copular predicate (a version of the thing exists in that colour), distinct from a Location, a framing/domain PP, or a property of the referent
focus particles (only/even/also/cleft) over a purely copular clause: the focus atom is defined as (<Op> <filler> <event>) and no event witness exists to fill the second slot
notes: Typing of the demonstrative "this shirt" and the bare property (Member sk_shirt_1 available) are both right; the whole defect is in how "in green" and the "also" focus were attached.
